### Showers
Author: Ray Ortlund
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/ray-ortlund/showers/
Passage: Ezekiel 34:26
Points:
- God's redemptive work advances most remarkably during extraordinary outpourings of the Holy Spirit.
- The Holy Spirit steadily attends and blesses ordinary gospel work when Christ is faithfully honored.
- Ministry functions on two distinct levels: God blessing routine labor and God unleashing supernatural acceleration.
- Believers must faithfully carry out their everyday calling while trusting God for heavenly outpourings only He can send.

### Showers of Blessing - Truth For Life - February 24
Author: Truth For Life
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-february-24-2019.html
Passage: Ezekiel 34:26
Points:
- The promised rain represents sovereign mercy that originates entirely with God and cannot be manufactured by human effort.
- Divine blessing is vital for spiritual growth, just as physical rain is essential for crops to thrive.
- God's grace is poured out in generous abundance rather than meager measures to preserve and sanctify His people.
- The Lord faithfully supplies refreshing relief at the exact season when His people encounter spiritual drought.
- God bestows diverse, interconnected blessings that encompass both saving grace and daily comfort.
